name: git
description: Git helpers: a fast add-all-and-commit flow, a guided merge with conflict repair and worktree cleanup, and idempotent per-spec worktree entry. Changelog (last 3): 1.14.0 — /git:merge Step 3 honours policy.mergeStrategy. 1.13.0 — The merge command now derives its merge strategy from merge-back inspect and offers it as the recommended default in one question, rather than stopping to ask for a strategy with no guidance. 1.12.0 — Commit scans the files it is about to stage for secrets (spec-paths secrets-scan) and asks before staging any hit — excluding them is the recommended default; secrets never stage silently.
